items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: His first professional engagements came in his early twenties with Benny Carter...

ctx.x: All the Benny Goodman stories are true you know. That tells a lot right there. And I just learned a lot with Flip Phillips, what a wonderful musician he is. And he is to this day. He’s 80 now and he still plays wonderfully, amazing, just great. And he was such a moving spirit in this band. I mean he always had a great sense of humor. And of course Bill Harris has a sense of humor. And we did a lot of laughing. It was great. Whenever Benny would start to get a little tense and you’d think what’s going to happen…
Well that’s great. We hope to see Flip in April in Florida.
